UDLText.Content: // If svn info does not return any information, add new file to repository by svn add command

Method.name: AddToSvn
Method.Implementation: set stat = 0 Set cmd = $$$SVNINFO _ " --username " _ $username _ " --password " _ passwd _ " " _ fullPath Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: " _ fullPath _ " svn info:" _ stat) If stat '= 0 { Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNINFO _" returned no information, add to SVN" ) Set cmd = $$$SVNADD _ " --username " _ $username _ " --password " _ passwd _ " " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit (-N) Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn add:" _ stat) } if ((stat = 0) && (commit = 1)) { Set cmd = $$$SVNCOMMIT _ " --username " _ $username _ " --password " _ passwd _ " -m ""Initialization"" " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn commit:" _ stat) } Quit stat

Method.name: UpdateInternalTime
Method.Implementation:
NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = nmSp set intTime= ##class(%RoutineMgr).TS(iName)
SET $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON"
Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile($NAMESPACE _ " UpdateInternalTime: " _ iName _ " " _ intTime )
&sql(UPDATE ITFCOMMON.SrcCtrlInfo SET ClassModifiedTime=:intTime WHERE InternalName=:iName )

Method.name: HTMLEncode
Method.Implementation: set i = 1 set newStr = "" while (i <= $L(inStr)) { set iC = $E(inStr, i, i) set newStr = newStr _ $SELECT(iC="<":"<", iC=">":">", iC="&":"&", iC="'":"'", iC="#":"#", 1:iC) set i = i + 1 } return newStr
